notes: G3 spec (amount+1 on the toughness magnitude). Printed: 'Attacking creatures you control get +1/+0.' Your 2/2 Bear attacks and becomes 3/2 (power only); the opponent's 2/2 blocks. Each deals lethal damage to the other: the 3/2 Bear takes 2 and dies (its toughness is still 2), the blocker takes 3 and dies. Warded Battlements (defender) stays home.
